notableFindings: Greenline 33 Hybrid consolidated into Greenline 33 as a propulsion variation, reducing duplicate model identities.
Fjord 36 Cruiser and 36 Open retained as distinct documented variants; the 36 Cruiser remains Initial because model-wide machinery data are incomplete.
Fjord 40 Open and 40 Cruiser retained as distinct documented variants with twin diesel propulsion; Open and Cruiser serve materially different use cases.
Saga 26 corrected from double-ender/aft-cabin displacement classification to Saga 26 HT hardtop cruiser with version-dependent semi-planing/planing characteristics.
Nord Star 31+ aligned to current factory dimensions, tankage and all-weather walkaround identity.
